calls.video_title: People Making Over $100,000 Per Year are Acting Like They are Living Paycheck to Paycheck
calls.thesis: Reiterates his 7 Apr buying-opportunity ranking (low conviction): stretched consumers, even $100k+ households shopping paycheck-to-paycheck, favour Dollar General, and margins are improving (4% to 5.6%, guide 6-8%).
calls.base_case: DCF $165 vs $126 — undervalued on his valuation.
calls.bull_case: Shrink/theft reduction and store investment lift margins toward the 6-8% guide.
calls.bear_case: He takes the under on analysts' 11.4% EPS growth (expects 7-9%): low-single-digit revenue growth industry, and he doubts management executes the turnaround.
